narrative.intro: Consolidated Nuclear Security has $489M in contract obligations for FY2027 to date. Consolidated Nuclear Security recorded a single award in the current fiscal year, so the average award size is $489M. Consolidated Nuclear Security obligations are down 85.3% year over year. Consolidated Nuclear Security obligations in prior fiscal years were $3.8B in FY22, $3.3B in FY23, $3.6B in FY24, $2.5B in FY25, and $3.3B in FY26. Consolidated Nuclear Security current-year totals are partial because they cover fiscal year to date. Consolidated Nuclear Security note states that all figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. Consolidated Nuclear Security recorded one award in FY2027 to date, which drives the single-award average.
